description.narrative:
This project aims to empower young people in Poland and Sierra Leone to become confident, informed, and active advocates in local decision-making processes. By strengthening young people’s understanding of how institutions work and building advocacy skills, the project supports meaningful youth participation in addressing key challenges such as unemployment, drug abuse, and climate change. Itis designed and led by young people, with a strong focus on including marginalised youth voices and turning experiences into policyinput.
Through international cooperation between youth-led organisations, local authorities, and educational institutions, the project creates long-term structures for youth engagement. A shared advocacy platform will enable young people from both countries to exchange tools and solutions, while sustained dialogue with local governments ensures youth perspectives are considered in decision-making.
The main goal of the project is to strengthen the capacity of young people in Polandand Sierra Leone to engage with local institutions and influence decisions that affect their lives, especially in relation to employment, social inclusion, climate justice,and youth participation. The project addresses the gap between young people, particularly those facing multiple barriers, and decision-makers by creating practical spaces for dialogue and advocacy.
In the short term, young participants will better understand howlocal institutions operate and will develop advocacy, communication, and policy-engagement skills. Through study visits and trainings, they will co-create concrete recommendations, while institutions gain deeper insight into youth realities.
In the longer term, the project aims to influence institutional practices and attitudes towards youth participation. The change we want to influence include practice of local institutions and the attitudes of young people. We want to engage and influence young marginalized communities (youth with different barriers) and connect institutions and decision-makers. Our approach will ensure that young people play an active role in shaping the outcome because a project created by young people <(>&<)> for young people, every project activity is counted, adapted to the youth's needs. Sustainable impact will be achieved through continued cooperation, use of the advocacy platform, and empowered youth beyond the project.

participating-org.narrative:
OUR VISION: Logos NGO envisions a society in which individuals are empowered through meaningful learning opportunities, active participation, and personal development. The organisation aims to have a positive impact on the communities it serves by acting consciously, responsibly, and with a strong sense of purpose in all its activities.
OUR VALUES The work of Logos NGO is grounded in the value of tolerance and inclusion. The organisation promotes equality and respect for diversity, regardless of nationality, religion, race, or abilities, and actively supports the inclusion of people with fewer opportunities. Logos NGO believes that diversity enricheslearning processes and strengthens social cohesion.
OUR MISSION Learning and continuous development are central to the organisation’s mission. Logos NGO fosters independent, critical, and objective thinking through non-formal education activities such as training courses, youth exchanges, and seminars. These initiatives aim to equip participants with skills, knowledge, and attitudes that support both personal growth and active citizenship. Flexibility and openness to new ideas guide the organisation’s approach to its work. LOGOS NGO adapts to changing contexts and challenges by embracing innovative methods and creative solutions. At the same time, the organisation values a positive and enjoyable working atmosphere, believing that motivation, well-being, and enjoyment enhance bothlearning outcomes and social impact.
OUR OBJECTIVES The organization aims to develop critical thinking, intercultural understanding, and social inclusion, particularly supporting minorities and migrants. Through local and international educational projects, training courses, youth exchanges, and outdoor learning activities, Logos strengthens young people’s soft skills, civic engagement, and capacity for active participation in diverse societies.
